snippet.title: EVERY Manager Cristiano Ronaldo Has Fallen Out With
snippet.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo has, unsurprisingly, thrown a tantrum after Jorge Jesus dared to leave him on the bench. This is not the first time Ronaldo has had a falling-out with a manager.

Ronaldo has thrown a wobbly and committed his own Saipan after he walked out of the Portuguese squad, claiming there were “reasons behind my departure” which he was not yet going to say. A bit like that ‘irrefutable proof’ Manchester City reckon they have.

The now 41-year-old, who is really too old to be doing this kind of thing, has apparently had a rift with Jesus but this is not the first time he has had a falling out.

Read the full article over at Planet Football: https://www.planetfootball.com/lists-and-rankings/cristiano-ronaldo-biggest-manager-fall-outs-portugal-exit

#CR7 #Football

snippet.title: Man City Next? 6 Teams STRIPPED Of Their Titles!
snippet.description:
Manchester City may be stripped of several titles after being found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules between 2009 and 2018.

During this period, City won three Premier League titles and several domestic cups, cementing themselves as the dominant force in the English game.

We’ve dusted off the history books to examine six other teams that were stripped of their titles long after the final whistle.

#MCFC #Football
